verdict.rationale: Cua ships an SDK, CLI and MCP surfaces, so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents no versioned API scheme and no deprecation policy. The "versioned drive" refers to file storage versioning, not API versioning, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
